stem: Which military need contributed to development of the technology described in this excerpt?

options.label: F
options.text: Faster, more accurate responses during combat

options.label: G
options.text: Stronger, more dependable weapons for soldiers

visual_elements: Navstar GPS is a satellite-based radio navigation system developed and operated by the US Department of Defense (DOD)... It consists of a constellation of orbiting satellites, a ground control system and thousands of GPS information receiver units in aircraft, ships, [and] land vehicles.... —“U.S. Military GPS,” www.army-technology.com (accessed May 7, 2018)
